newsitem.title: USA: TWA to cut deeply at New York hub - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: TWA to cut deeply at New York hub - WSJ.

text.p: Trans World Airlines plans deep cuts at its New York hub at Kennedy Airport as part of a realignment to stem huge losses on trans-Atlantic flights, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.

The idea is to shrink capacity by 10 percent, reduce costs by nearly $400 million a year, furlough hundreds of employees, ground its Boeing 747 and Lockheed L-1011 jumbo jets and consolidate operations at Kennedy into one terminal, the story says.
The steps will result in charges against earnings in the coming quarters, says the story, which is based on an interview with TWA's Senior Vice President of Planning and Marketing Roden Brandt.
